name: task
description: Launch a sub-agent to handle a complex, multi-step task. The sub-agent runs autonomously with access to built-in tools (read, task) and returns its result as text. Use this to delegate research, file analysis, or any multi-step work.

description.description: Short description of what the sub-agent will do (used for logging).

prompt.description: Detailed instructions for the sub-agent. Be specific about what to investigate and what to return.

model.description: Optional model override (e.g. 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'). Defaults to the model of the calling provider.
